description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing verified resources (emails and phone numbers) within organization teams, including endpoints for requesting verification codes, verifying codes, and retrieving verified resources.

classes.name: OrgTeamsVerifiedResourcesController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling verified resource operations (emails and phones) for organization teams, including requesting verification codes, verifying codes, and listing verified resources.

methods.name: requestEmailVerificationCode
methods.description: Handles request to send an email verification code to a specified email address.

methods.name: requestPhoneVerificationCode
methods.description: Handles request to send a phone verification code to a specified phone number.

methods.name: verifyEmail
methods.description: Verifies an email address using a provided verification code.

methods.name: verifyPhoneNumber
methods.description: Verifies a phone number using a provided verification code.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of verified emails for a specific organization team.

methods.name: getVerifiedPhoneNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of verified phone numbers for a specific organization team.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmailById
methods.description: Retrieves details of a verified email by its ID for a specific team.

methods.name: getVerifiedPhoneById
methods.description: Retrieves details of a verified phone number by its ID for a specific team.
